_doc: Optional project hooks for Autopilot scripts. Safe to customize; not overwritten blindly on methodology sync if listed in METHODOLOGY.lock customized_files.
notes: Set prod_smoke_cmd to a shell command that exits 0 when production is healthy, e.g. "curl -fsS https://example.com/health". Or set env PROD_SMOKE_CMD. Leave null to skip live smoke (watchdog still records main sha).
